summary: Phase 7b-ext backend testing completed. Fixed critical role migration bug. Verified role taxonomy migration, normalization, RBAC structure, onboarding endpoints, and audit endpoints. Auth-gated endpoint tests require live Supabase credentials.

critical_bugs.issue: invites_col was defined AFTER migrate_legacy_role_names() function, causing NameError during migration
critical_bugs.impact: Role migration from legacy taxonomy (agent/operator/manager/admin) to Quantro taxonomy (viewer/member/accountant/leader) was failing silently
critical_bugs.fix_applied: Moved workspace_invites_col definition to top of file (line 78) with other collection definitions. Renamed all invites_col references to workspace_invites_col for consistency. Added error logging instead of silent exception swallowing.
critical_bugs.verification: Migration now successfully converts 4 legacy roles. Verified in MongoDB: agent→viewer, operator→member, manager→accountant, admin→leader

verified_working.details: migrate_legacy_role_names() runs on app boot and successfully converts legacy roles to Quantro taxonomy. Idempotent - safe to run multiple times.
_normalize_role() correctly translates all legacy role names to canonical Quantro roles. Handles case-insensitivity and whitespace. Returns 'viewer' as default for invalid roles.
ROLE_RANK correctly defines hierarchy: viewer(1) < member(2) < accountant(3) < leader(4) < owner(5). role_rank() function correctly normalizes legacy roles before ranking.

ONBOARDING_STEPS defines 5 canonical steps: invitation_sent, account_created, companies_assigned, role_configured, first_login. _onboarding_status_overall() correctly computes rollup status (pending/in_progress/completed/blocked).
All required collections exist: workspace_members, workspace_invites, people_onboarding_steps, audit_log, users, workspaces.

All 4 new endpoints correctly return 401 Unauthorized without Bearer token: GET /api/workspaces/{id}/onboarding, POST /api/workspaces/{id}/onboarding/{member_user_id}/steps/{step_key}, POST /api/workspaces/{id}/onboarding/{member_user_id}/complete, GET /api/workspaces/{id}/audit
Health endpoint responds correctly. Backend is running and accepting requests.

passed_tests: Role migration function executes without error
Legacy roles (agent/operator/manager/admin) successfully converted to Quantro roles (viewer/member/accountant/leader)
_normalize_role() function works correctly for all role types
role_rank() function correctly ranks roles with normalization

high_priority.item: Verify RBAC enforcement with live users
high_priority.details: Test require_role('leader') and require_role('accountant') with actual authenticated users of different roles. Current test credentials (josias.martin@hotmail.com, josias.martin90@hotmail.com) are invalid.
Verify GET /api/workspaces/{id}/onboarding returns correct member onboarding state with all 5 steps, progress calculation, and status rollup. Test with authenticated leader+ user.

Verify POST /api/workspaces/{id}/onboarding/{member_user_id}/steps/{step_key} correctly: (1) rejects unknown step_key with 400, (2) rejects invalid status with 400, (3) allows leader+ or self to update, (4) blocks member from updating another member's steps with 403.
Verify POST /api/workspaces/{id}/onboarding/{member_user_id}/complete correctly: (1) forces all 5 steps to completed, (2) requires leader+ role (member → 403).

Verify GET /api/workspaces/{id}/audit correctly: (1) requires leader+ role (member → 403), (2) returns events newest-first, (3) hydrates actor and target user objects, (4) filters by member_user_id query param.

medium_priority.details: Either: (1) Create confirmed Supabase users for testing, or (2) Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md with valid credentials, or (3) Use Supabase admin API to create test users programmatically.
